channel_units: uint8 0-255; mean absolute change across RGB channels
foreground_filter: minimum RGB channel > 64 in both adjacent frames; approximate interior, not authoritative mask
limitations: Frame differences include geometry movement and deformation; high maximum individual pixel differences at silhouette crossings do not prove color flashes.
The bright foreground filter is a measurement heuristic; unchanged coverage raster remains the authoritative geometry.
Material coordinates use a smooth Gaussian-weighted inverse-displacement approximation during deformation, not a globally invertible UV map.
This is an independent technical/artistic observation; creator artistic acceptance remains pending.
